ticker: Thousands detained in Delhi over election commissioner protest
Missile strike hits Riyadh airport, conferences to proceed
India implements tough dollar curbs to defend rupee
Supreme Court schedules Sunday hearing over Delhi Metro closures
UN Human Rights expresses concern over mass detentions in India

articles.headline: India Detains Thousands and Locks Down Delhi Over Protests
articles.whyItMatters: Mass detentions highlight rising political tensions over election roll revisions.
articles.brief: Delhi police detained thousands of protesters, political leaders, and activists attempting to demonstrate against Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar, causing widespread transport shutdowns.

articles.headline: India Unveils Tough Currency Curbs to Defend Rupee
articles.whyItMatters: New financial measures aim to stabilize the currency amid high dollar demand.
articles.brief: Indian authorities introduced strict new curbs on dollar demand in an aggressive effort to defend the weakening rupee against global economic pressures.

articles.headline: Missile Strike Hits Riyadh Airport, Multiple Wounded
articles.whyItMatters: Renewed regional security threats impact international travel and major conferences.
articles.brief: An explosion and reported missile strike at Riyadh airport left multiple people wounded and forced flight diversions, though organizers confirmed major Saudi conferences will proceed.

articles.headline: UN Human Rights Expresses Concern Over Mass Detentions
articles.whyItMatters: International scrutiny focuses on India's handling of peaceful demonstrators.
articles.brief: The UN Human Rights office urged Indian authorities to exercise utmost restraint and immediately release detainees following mass crackdowns on protests in Delhi and Mumbai.

articles.headline: Supreme Court to Hold Special Sunday Hearing on Metro Closures
articles.whyItMatters: Judicial intervention addresses alleged infringement on civilian movement and rights.
articles.brief: The Supreme Court scheduled a special Sunday sitting to address a contempt petition challenging the extensive closure of Delhi Metro stations and transit services during protests.

articles.headline: NYC Mayor Enforces New Click-to-Cancel Rule for Subscriptions
articles.whyItMatters: Consumer protection laws target difficult online cancellation processes for major tech services.
articles.brief: New York City Mayor Zohran Mamdani's Click-to-Cancel rule is officially live, forcing tech and media companies like Netflix and Amazon to offer seamless subscription cancellations.

articles.headline: Earthquake of Magnitude 4.2 Strikes Uttarakhand's Uttarkashi
articles.whyItMatters: Seismic activity in vulnerable mountainous regions causes widespread public panic.
articles.brief: A 4.2-magnitude earthquake struck Uttarkashi, triggering panic as residents rushed outdoors during the night. No immediate structural damage or casualties were reported.

articles.headline: Anushka Yadav Claims Hammer Throw Gold at National Open Athletics
articles.whyItMatters: National athletic championships highlight top-tier emerging sporting talent in the country.
articles.brief: Anushka Yadav delivered an impressive performance to secure the hammer throw gold medal at the ongoing National Open Athletics championships.
